minutes.headline: Cemetery Commission approved updated rules and regulations and set a noon Dec 2 meeting to fund the back-lot expansion.
minutes.summary: Bids for the North Cemetery back-lot expansion all came in above expectations, so the commission will meet separately to decide on funding from the sale of lots fund. They reviewed a revised rules and regulations draft, changed wording on plantings and tree planting, and moved to approve it. They also discussed the West Street Terrace easement and the pricing rollout.

votes.motion: Approve the new rules and regulations

budget_items.what_was_said: Nine bids were received, all higher than expected; the low bidder was a landscaping company and the highest was far above.
Some money is left in the capital project and a further commitment would be needed to cover the low bid.
The sale of lots capital fund balance was stated and members were surprised it was higher than they remembered.
Perpetual care interest was discussed as usable for maintenance and improvements.
A contractor offered to finish remaining stone straightening at the same price as the prior section.
Lot sales split between the commission and the town for perpetual care.
Second interment price for cremation discussed.

January meeting to be decided later, likely by Zoom.
Before pursuing the West Street Terrace easement, talk to the attorney, survey and landowner and assign costs.

what_happened.line: The Cemetery Commission set a short meeting for noon on Wednesday, December 2, to discuss and vote on paying for the back-lot expansion from the sale of lots fund.
All nine bids for the North Cemetery back-lot expansion came in higher than expected, and money left in the capital project would not cover the low bid.
The commission reviewed a revised rules and regulations draft, changed the planting and tree-planting wording, and moved to approve it; the vote was not audible.
The December 17 meeting was cancelled, and the January meeting is to be decided later, likely by Zoom.
Before pursuing the West Street Terrace easement, the commission will talk to the attorney, surveyor and landowner and assign costs.

why_it_matters: The expansion would add burial space at North Cemetery, and the commission is looking at the sale of lots fund, which is lot-sale money rather than the general tax levy, to cover the gap left by high bids.
The new rules and regulations set how plantings and trees are handled on cemetery lots, so they affect families who visit or maintain graves.
